name: regression-final-commit
goal: Complete regression verification after committing proof bookkeeping while requiring current intact verification and performance evidence.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: At 11160916a, the read-only final proof gate rejects the valid mobile-header pair solely because its loop notes were committed afterward. Final verification must retain the immutable pair and separately audit current source.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The existing loop CLI matrix checks final rejection only at the original fix commit, before committing loop bookkeeping. Extend that same three-template matrix across a metadata commit and a legacy loop without a completion declaration; both must reach the current completion audit and remain pending without evidence.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 0416b4c8d immutable proof aa1527d1 records three real failures across bug-fix, fix and regression-prevention. After a bookkeeping commit the final CLI reports current-tested-commit instead of reaching the completion audit; four existing cases pass. The standard matrix and command are frozen.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Keep exact tested-commit requirements for red, green and guard checkpoints. Final verify validates its unchanged historical red/green pair, then requires the current TaskCompletionService audit even for legacy loops without completion metadata. Never relabel historical proof as current.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Final verification validates the stored immutable red/green pair after bookkeeping commits. The loop completion owner requires the current task audit for regression verify, including legacy loops; red, green and guard keep exact-commit checks.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 70fc281d5 proof 5b447994 passes all seven unchanged standard CLI cases, including metadata commits and legacy loops. The paired red aa1527d1 fails the three repair templates. Focused planning, task-completion and loop tests also pass all fourteen cases with profiling requested.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Fresh isolated recurrence records the original failure at 0416b4c8d as 8c531300 and the restored passing repair at 70fc281d5 as 94482e08. Same command, test/config corpus and environment are retained. Full current-source verification remains pending.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
